goal: Compute aggregate vendor cost and apply the 60% requesting-party allocation.
prompt:
Meridian's allocated share of the e-discovery vendor costs must be recorded on the discovery cost ledger. Query the document index and locate the discovery cost-sharing stipulation with the vendor cost report for Meridian v. Corvess. Read it in full. Compute the aggregate vendor cost from the stated rates and volumes (processing, hosting, and first-pass review), then apply the stipulated allocation percentage that the requesting party bears. Round to whole dollars. Record the result using notes_create for litigation_discovery_001, with production_cost set to Meridian's allocated share and changed_by_role set to exactly discovery_manager. Record the allocated share, not the full vendor total.
